hero_title: Unit 8 · It must belong to Carla.

knowledge.d: must 一定（几乎肯定）＞ may/might/could 可能 ＞ can't 不可能。例：It must be Carla's.
对现在情况推测：情态动词＋动词原形。It must be Mary's.（一定是玛丽的）名词所有格 's 表归属。
belong to 属于，后接名词或代词宾格：must belong to Carla. 不说 belong to hers / Carla's.
问物品归属：Whose book is this? 答常用名词所有格：It must be Mary's.
线索推断：有校服→must go to our school；有发带→can't be a boy；球场捡球→must belong to a player.
must/might/could + have done 推测过去：must have picked it up（一定有人捡走了）。知道含义即可。
Victor夜闻怪声：妻子猜 could be an animal，警察猜 might be the wind，Helen 断定 can't be a dog.
Paul Stoker 认为"神庙说"can't be true（首领到得晚）；也有人猜 might be a calendar 或治病场所。

belong to 属于 hair band 发带 at the picnic 在野餐时 run after 追赶 must have done 对过去推测

questions.q: —____ book is this? —It must be Mary's.
questions.exp: 询问"谁的"用 Whose，后接名词：Whose book is this? Who 问人（主语），Whom 是宾格，Which 表"哪一个"，都不能修饰 book。

questions.q: —Whose volleyball is this? —It ____ be Carla's. She loves volleyball.
questions.exp: 卡拉爱打排球→见到排球几乎肯定"一定是卡拉的"，用 must；即 1a/1b 原句 It must be Carla's.

questions.q: The toy truck must belong to ____. He was the only little kid at the picnic.
questions.exp: belong to 后接代词宾格：belong to him（属于他）。he 是主格、his 是物主代词、himself 是反身代词，均不能作 to 的宾语。

questions.q: —Whose book is this? —It must be ____. J. K. Rowling is her favorite writer.
questions.exp: must be 后用名词所有格表归属：It must be Mary's.（一定是玛丽的）。用 belong to 才说 belong to Mary，本句没有 belong to。

questions.q: —Whose hair band is this? —It could be Mei's, or it might ____ to Linda. They both have long hair.
questions.exp: Grammar Focus 原句：It might belong to Linda. might 是情态动词，后接动词原形 belong；两人都可能，故用 could/might 表"可能"。

questions.q: Here is a hair band in the schoolbag, so the person ____ be a boy.
questions.exp: 发带是女孩常用之物→几乎肯定不是男孩，用 can't 表否定推测（2b 原句：the person can't be a boy）。

questions.q: There is a school T-shirt in the schoolbag, so the person ____ go to our school.
questions.exp: 校服是本校的→几乎肯定就读于我们学校，用 must（2b 原句：the person must go to our school）。

questions.q: After the basketball game, Sam found a basketball on the court. No one else was there. It ____ belong to one of the players.
questions.exp: 刚打完球、球场无其他人→几乎肯定是某个球员落下的，用 must 表强推测。mustn't 表禁止、needn't 表不必、shouldn't 表不应该，均不用于推测。

questions.q: Mom: Do you have anything valuable in your schoolbag? Linda: No, just my books, my pink hair band and some tennis balls. Mom: So it ____ be stolen.
questions.exp: 书包里没有值钱东西→几乎肯定不是被偷，用 can't 表否定推测（2d 原句：So it can't be stolen.）。

questions.q: —Whose CD is this? —It must ____ Grace. She always listens to pop music.
questions.exp: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形：must belong to Grace（一定属于格蕾丝）。belongs 用于无must的第三人称现在时；belonging 不能直接作谓语。

questions.q: —I can't find my schoolbag. —Don't worry. I think somebody must have ____ it up.
questions.exp: 对过去动作推测用 must have done：must have picked it up（一定有人捡走了），pick up 的过去分词是 picked（2d 原句）。

questions.q: Historian Paul Stoker thinks it ____ be true that Stonehenge was a temple, because the leaders arrived in England much later.
questions.exp: 首领们到英国比巨石阵建成晚得多→"神庙说"几乎肯定不对，用 can't（课文原句：he thinks this can't be true）。

questions.q: Some people think the stones of Stonehenge can ____ illness and keep people healthy.
questions.exp: prevent illness 预防疾病（课文原句：the stones can prevent illness and keep people healthy）。receive 收到、express 表达、circle 围成圈，均不合句意。

questions.q: Linda couldn't remember where she put her schoolbag because she ____ a concert yesterday.
questions.exp: yesterday 表过去→用一般过去时 attended；attend a concert 出席音乐会（2d 原句：I attended a concert yesterday.）。

questions.q: The woman in the area said, "I think it was too big to be a dog. Maybe it was a bear or a ____."
questions.exp: 3a 课文原句：Maybe it was a bear or a wolf.（也许是熊或狼）兔子、鸭子、羊都不可能被误认为巨大的黑影。

questions.q: —Where's Jean? —I'm not sure. She ____ be in the laboratory.
questions.exp: 答话人自己都不确定（I'm not sure）→用 might 表把握较小的推测（4a 原题答案：She might be in the laboratory.）。

flashcards.q: It must be Carla's. She loves volleyball.
flashcards.a: 一定是卡拉的，她爱打排球。must 表几乎肯定的推测；Carla's = Carla's volleyball，名词所有格后可省略上文提过的名词。

flashcards.q: It could be Mei's hair band. Or it might belong to Linda.
flashcards.a: 这可能是梅的发带，也可能属于琳达——两人都留长发，不能确定，用 could / might 表"可能"；belong to 后接人名或宾格代词。
所以它不可能是被偷的。can't 表否定推测（几乎肯定不是）。书包里没有贵重物品，故排除"被偷"。注意 mustn't 表禁止，不能用来表推测。

flashcards.q: Whose book is this? — It must be Mary's.
flashcards.a: 这是谁的书？——一定是玛丽的。whose 询问归属；回答用名词所有格：must be Mary's（J. K. Rowling 是她最爱的作家，课文 1b）。
belong to 属于，to 是介词，后接名词或代词宾格：The hair band must belong to Carla. / It might belong to Linda. 不能说 belong to hers，也不能说 belong to Carla's。

flashcards.q: I think somebody must have picked it up.
flashcards.a: 我想一定有人把它捡走了。对过去情况的推测用 must have done（一定做过某事）：somebody must have picked it up；pick up 捡起，其过去分词为 picked。

flashcards.q: 3a 课文《Strange Happenings in My Town》各方观点
flashcards.a: Victor 妻子：could be an animal；Victor 和朋友：must be teenagers having fun；警察：might be the wind；Helen：先猜 dog 又排除 can't be a dog；一位妇人：too big to be a dog, maybe a bear or a wolf。

flashcards.q: Stonehenge 巨石阵的种种猜测
flashcards.a: 曾用作 temple（与神沟通）→Paul Stoker 认为 can't be true；又猜 might be a calendar（夏至日出直照石阵中心）；或是治病场所（prevent illness）；但石块位置 must be for a special purpose.
belong to 属于；hair band 发带；at the picnic 在野餐时；run after 追赶（The alien is running after the man!）；too...to... 太……而不能……（too big to be a dog）。

truck 卡车 picnic 野餐 attend 出席 valuable 贵重的 pink 粉红的 noise 噪音 policeman 警察 wolf 狼 laboratory 实验室 outdoors 在户外 coat 外套 sleepy 困倦的 land 着陆 suit 西装 express 表达 circle 圆圈 Britain 英国 receive 接待/收到 leader 首领 prevent 阻止 energy 能量 position 位置 victory 胜利 enemy 敌人 period 时期 mystery 奥秘 mysterious 神秘的

errors.title: belong to 后误接物主代词或所有格
errors.wrong: 把句子写成 The hair band must belong to hers. 或 This book must belong to Carla's.
errors.right: belong to 的 to 是介词，后接名词或代词宾格：belong to Carla / belong to her。hers 是名词性物主代词，Carla's 是所有格，都不能跟在介词 to 后面。

errors.title: 把 mustn't 当作"不可能"用
errors.wrong: 把"书包不可能是被偷的"写成 So it mustn't be stolen.
errors.right: 否定推测（不可能）要用 can't：So it can't be stolen. mustn't 只表"禁止、不准"（You mustn't smoke here.），不用于推测。

errors.title: must be 后漏掉名词所有格 's
errors.wrong: 回答 Whose book is this? 时写成 It must be Mary.（漏掉所有格）
errors.right: "一定是玛丽的（书）"要说 It must be Mary's.（Mary's = Mary's book），所有格 's 不能丢；只有 belong to 结构才接人名：It must belong to Mary.

errors.title: 情态动词后误加 to 或误用三单
errors.wrong: 把 It might belong to Linda. 写成 It might to belong to Linda. 或 The magazine might belongs to Deng Wen.
errors.right: 情态动词（must / could / might / can't）后一律接动词原形：might belong to。实义动词现在时第三人称单数才加 s：The magazine belongs to Deng Wen.

errors.title: 对过去推测漏掉 have done
errors.wrong: 想表达"一定有人捡走了书包"却写成 I think somebody must picked it up.
errors.right: 对过去动作的推测用 must / might / could + have + 过去分词：must have picked it up（picked 是 pick up 的过去分词）。情态动词后不能直接跟过去式。

errors.title: whose 与 who 混用
errors.wrong: 问"这是谁的书"时写成 Who book is this?
errors.right: "谁的"用 whose：Whose book is this? who 意为"谁"（作主语），不能直接修饰名词；"这本书是谁的"可说 Whose is this book?（whose 独立作表语）。
